description: Tier contract for the project-rag duty. Read by the DoE hooks (nags, duty text) and imported by the engine, which alone aborts a run. Core holds the generic tier mechanism; an installed provider registers a stricter tier under `providers`.

halt_reason_notes.project_rag_unused: a gated agent made zero project-rag tool_use attempts; a failed call is an attempt
halt_reason_notes.project_rag_cadence: a provider tier's cadence window held fewer project-rag calls than its minimum
halt_reason_notes.project_rag_not_serving: structural failure: no project-rag tool loadable or answering; never a semantic-only miss
halt_reason_notes.ue_corpus_gap: the provider's corpus lacks the knowledge the claim needs

providers.duty_text: THE ENGINE ABORTS THE RUN IF ANY WINDOW OF {window_tool_calls} CONSECUTIVE TOOL CALLS HOLDS FEWER THAN {min_rag_calls} PROJECT-RAG CALLS. THE ENGINE ABORTS THE RUN IF PROJECT-RAG IS NOT SERVING. THE ENGINE ABORTS THE RUN IF THE UNREAL ENGINE CORPUS LACKS THE KNOWLEDGE YOUR CLAIM NEEDS. A FAILED CALL STILL COUNTS AS AN ATTEMPT AND IS NEVER A REASON TO STOP; REPORT IT AS A GAP AND CONTINUE. YOU DO NOT KNOW UNREAL ENGINE FROM MEMORY, AND GREP AND GLOB CANNOT STAND IN FOR THE CORPUS: CALL PROJECT-RAG REGULARLY.
